title: Krull dimension of a topological space
statement:
Let $X$ be a topological space. A *chain of irreducible closed subsets* of $X$ of *length* $n$ is a sequence $Z_0\subsetneq Z_1\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq Z_n$ of closed subsets of $X$ each of which is irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components] (in particular nonempty). The *Krull dimension* $\dim X$ of $X$ is the element of $\{-\infty,0,1,2,\ldots,\infty\}$

$$
\dim X=\sup\{n: \text{there is a chain of irreducible closed subsets of $X$ of length $n$}\},
$$

so that $\dim X=-\infty$ if and only if $X$ is empty. For a subset $Y\subseteq X$, $\dim Y$ is the Krull dimension of $Y$ with the subspace topology.
